question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing striker, and Eve is playing center midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) goalkeeper
(C) right back
(D) striker
(E) center midfielder
solution:
Positions are listed in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve).
Initial: (right winger, goalkeeper, right back, striker, center midfielder)
1. Claire swaps with Eve: (right winger, goalkeeper, center midfielder, striker, right back)
2. Claire swaps with Bob: (right winger, center midfielder, goalkeeper, striker, right back)
3. Claire swaps with Dave: (right winger, center midfielder, striker, goalkeeper, right back)
4. Bob swaps with Claire: (right winger, striker, center midfielder, goalkeeper, right back)
5. Claire swaps with Bob: (right winger, center midfielder, striker, goalkeeper, right back)
Eve is playing right back, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
